technical.summary: Oversold conditions present but overwhelmed by bearish structure, negative momentum, and weak trend confirmation—insufficient confluence for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 33 days—fundamental backdrop is weak.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, junior/mid-tier members
sentiment.summary: Congressional selling pressure is weak and dated (4+ months old); broad market fear (41 Fear/Greed score) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (207.6) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just passed, and earnings in 33 days add event risk to an already hostile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold oscillators (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with broad market fear (41 Fear/Greed) and proximity to support (75.83) create a contrarian mean-reversion setup for risk-tolerant traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish structure dominates across all timeframes (price below all MAs, MACD negative, three black crows, Ichimoku below cloud), macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC just passed), earnings event risk in 33 days, and no institutional or insider conviction—oversold conditions alone cannot overcome this confluence of headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold oscillators and broad market fear create a contrarian setup, but bearish structure (price below all MAs, three black crows, MACD negative) and hostile macro (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) overwhelm mean-reversion logic.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 33 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creates compounding event and macro risk that oversold conditions cannot justify.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish conviction despite oversold technicals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 11 other Industrials positions (34% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk without conviction improvement.
